snippet.title: Space Control | The Most Chaotic VR Space Job Sim | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You've been abducted by an intergalactic megacorporation, Glorpo Inc! Work off your debt with your alien crew - abduct new recruits, take care of alien babies and cook up some questionable space snacks! Watch the Space Control announcement trailer for this upcoming VR narrative adventure simulation game. Space Control will be available on Meta Quest and Steam on April 1st 2026. 

A demo is out on Steam as part of Steam Next Fest, which runs from February 23 to March 2, 2026.

Find Space Control here on stores: 
🔹Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1759150/Space_Control/
🔹Meta: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/space-control/7192215547457949/

📱 All Socials: https://linktr.ee/MoonMonsterStudios
👾 Official IGDB page: https://www.igdb.com/games/space-control

Glory to Glorpo Inc!
